comment: Destination profiles for the rehearsal service (S2, B11/P14). Names and paths only, no secret values. The agent sees the target's profile in its envelope (inputs.destination_profile) so secret paths come from the real destination, not from a guess; the private verifier refuses OpenBao paths and ExternalSecret keys outside secret_store.path_prefix. Values measured on bravo-onprem 2026-11-03 02:4x KST (Deployment chat/chat-bravo-demo, Secret bravo-demo-db, ObjectBucket obc-chat-bravo-demo-attachments, keys.sh env-fields).

engine_facts: Ceph RGW sets the condition key aws:SecureTransport only on TLS requests; on a plain-HTTP request the key is absent. A Deny meant for plain HTTP must therefore use BoolIfExists {aws:SecureTransport: false}: with Bool it never matches (measured 2026-11-03 03:0x KST, docs/evidence/s2-full 03-05). The destination's existing statement DenyInsecureTransport uses BoolIfExists.
With SSE-KMS default encryption a plain-HTTP GET that no policy refuses is answered 400 InvalidRequest, which the gate's OBJ-06 counts as UNKNOWN (not a refusal).
